record.paper_title: Open problems in stochastic reinforcement models
record.original_question: For the critical WARM with alpha = 1 on the integer-line graph G=Z and uniform firing rates p(v)=1, do the scaled reinforced edge weights converge almost surely to the constant equilibrium 1 at every location, i.e. does x_v(t) -> 1 for all v as t -> infinity?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2. For G = Z with firing rates p(v) ≡ 1, one has almost surely ∀v xv(t) → 1, as t → ∞.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the Weakly Reinforced ARM (WARM) on the integer-line graph $G=(V,E)$ with $V=\mathbb{Z}$ and edges between consecutive integers. Each vertex $v\in\mathbb{Z}$ has a uniform firing rate $p(v)=1$ and fires according to an independent Poisson process. At each firing time of vertex $v$, one of the two edges incident to $v$ is selected and its weight is incremented by $1$; the probability of selecting an incident edge $e$ at the firing time is proportional to $W_e(t-)^{\alpha}$, where $W_e(t)$ denotes the current integer weight of edge $e$ and $\alpha>0$ is the reinforcement parameter. Fix the critical exponent $\alpha=1$. For each edge $e$ define the scaled (normalized) edge weight $x_e(t):=W_e(t)/\bar W(t)$, where $\bar W(t)$ is the average weight in a way that makes the constant configuration $1$ the natural equilibrium (equivalently, $x_e(t)=2W_e(t)/(W_{e^-}(t)+W_{e^+}(t))$ in the local pairwise normalization centered at each vertex, so that uniform weights correspond to $x\equiv 1$). 

Prove or disprove: almost surely, for every edge $v$ of $\mathbb{Z}$, 
$$x_v(t)\longrightarrow 1\quad\text{as }t\to\infty.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as a conjecture about the critical WARM on Z. Recent literature on WARM (van der Hofstad–Holmes–Kuznetsov–Ruszel and follow-up "Infinite WARM graphs" series, including the strong reinforcement regime work by Hirsch–Holmes and others up through 2023) addresses the regimes α>1 and α<1/2 on various graphs, but the critical case α=1 on Z with uniform firing rates is still listed as an open conjecture, and no proof or counterexample was located in the available sources.

status_evidence.title: Infinite WARM graphs III: strong reinforcement regime
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on WARM models focuses on the strong reinforcement regime α>1; the critical case α=1 is not resolved there.
status_evidence.claim: Recent WARM literature treats α>1; the critical α=1 case on Z remains open.

status_evidence.title: Strongly reinforced Pólya urns with graph-based competition
status_evidence.snippet: Studies equilibria of WARM, showing for α<1/2 every edge is reinforced a positive proportion of the time; critical α=1 is not addressed.
status_evidence.claim: Existing results cover α<1/2 and α>1 but not the critical α=1 convergence to uniform equilibrium on Z.
